description: Operator-owned principal map for the intake relay (plan p2-wake-on-work, B12). EXAMPLE with placeholder values only — the real map is owner-installed outside the repository, readable only by the relay service user (0600 / 0750). The fingerprint is the SSH key fingerprint sshd presents (ExposeAuthInfo, `publickey SHA256:…`). Client-supplied principal fields are always overwritten by the resolver output; these entries are the ONLY source of principal identity, scope, and payload bounds.
